title: Development of fully automated deep-learning-based approach for prediction of sentinel lymph node metastasis in breast cancer patients using ultrasound imaging.
summary: Methods and Results/proof passages support the result and scope summarized in reason. Methods identify the ML/deep-learning operation used for the specific result. Testing: Methods/Results specify cohort, reference/outcome, split or experimental comparator and limitations.. Original full text, Methods/Results: automated ultrasound segmentation and CNN image features combined with clinical data predicted pathologically confirmed sentinel-node status; two-hospital retrospective cohorts included an external hospital test (n=113), AUC about .765.
